prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Liu Bei from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the benevolent founder of Shu Han, who swore sisterhood in the Peach Garden. mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

Style: Korean MMORPG 3D key art — a semi-realistic 3D beauty with a small refined face and delicate realistic-anime features, porcelain skin with a soft glow, extremely ornate engraved armour and jewellery with glossy highlights, a strong rim light and drifting light particles, a luxurious promotional finish.

Her: a soft, gentle warmth; warm beige skin; round face; large eyes — large round eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; soft rounded brows; straight narrow nose; full wide lips; amber eyes; a bare, makeup-free face. curvy build; long wavy hair with side-swept bangs; warm chestnut-brown hair.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes keep the shape described above at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Her legend: benevolence and humility that win hearts, humble straw-sandal beginnings under imperial Han blood, long jade earrings as her mark of fortune, the twin swords of the Peach Garden oath, tears shed for her people.

Outfit: a command-type mecha — crowned head unit with an antenna crest, cape-like binder wings, heavy chest plating with an emblem core, a flagship back unit; colours jade green, imperial gold, earthen brown, white jade. EXPOSURE (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

She holds a pair of matched twin swords in one double scabbard, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette.

Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer, one hand resting on her signature item. Expression: a warm, gentle look with a faint smile.

Setting: year 2190, the Shu frontier colony on a jade-green moon: terraced garden cities under vast glass domes, a ringed gas giant filling the sky, an orbital elevator climbing into space, starship docks glowing green.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

Light: a strong soft rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour, glossy highlights on metal, skin and jewellery, drifting light particles and a luxurious promotional glow.

One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a far-future setting only — no traditional East-Asian architecture, pagodas or tiled roofs; no hanzi; no logo or watermark.

observations: One adult female figure; full body and both boots visible.
Both arms and both hands present; no obvious extra limbs.
Twin sword hilts and paired scabbard silhouette visible.
Cloth-like embroidered tabard and cape panels are mixed with solid mecha plates. Thigh exposure is greater than the two specified chest/midriff openings.
Space colony, ringed planet and futuristic armour visible.

acceptance: User authorized image and dex commits plus non-force main push; selected samguk/fantasy/mecha 1,1,1 on 2026-11-09. Returned images preserved without exposure-related regeneration.
